name: manager_team_absences_us_november
use_case: Show a manager their team's absences
branch: A US engineering manager checks absences for his direct reports during November 2026.
tests: Retrieves manager profile and reports scheduled absences for US manager M01 in November.
instruction:
You are Michael Scott (manager ID M01), engineering manager for the US team. You want to see who in your direct team is taking time off during the month of November 2026 (from 2026-11-01 to 2026-11-30). Ask the leave desk to pull up the team absences for your direct reports during this period.

Your details:
- Manager ID: M01
- Name: Michael Scott
- Start Date: 2026-11-01
- End Date: 2026-11-30

persona.name: Michael Scott
persona.initial_message: Hi HR desk, could you show me who on my team has scheduled absences in November 2026? My manager ID is M01.
